description.label: Description
description.value:
Your body consists of mechanical machine parts; cogs, pistons and so on.

  • Arms: @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.mDgEMOoJpi8DkRYb]{Magical}, +3 AP. Pick one: +5 Strength per arm or @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.4MJJCiOKPkBByYwW]{Strike Mighty Blow}, +60% weight.
  • Legs: @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.mDgEMOoJpi8DkRYb]{Magical}, +3 AP. Roll 1d10: (1-5) Piston Legs, @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.CV9btQn09S9Fn8Jk]{Strong Legs}, @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.AwUUEwwf2Vt4ksCN]{Sprinter}; (6-7) Wheels, +4 Movement, @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.UmxGZRV0Lw3TZ0Kx]{Stride}, Movement 1 in stairs; (8) Hover, levitate up to 2 yards; (9-10) Tracks, +2 Movement, @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.UmxGZRV0Lw3TZ0Kx]{Stride}. +180% weight.
  • Body: @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.mDgEMOoJpi8DkRYb]{Magical}, +3 AP, +10 Strength, +20 @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.k9539MBTFplxsysT]{Tough}ness, -10 Agility, +300% weight.
  • Head: @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.mDgEMOoJpi8DkRYb]{Magical}, +3 AP, +10 Willpower. Pick two: @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.UaDGF5MBFBwPq5YU]{Iron Jaw}, @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.pLW9SVX0TVTYPiPv]{Bite} (SB+3), @UUID[Compendium.artantares-mutations.items.Item.gvaCIj4BqHLSR5eE]{Dark Vision}, @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.9h82z72XGo9tfgQS]{Acute Sense} (Sight), @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.sBHarYXR2o7jD1VY]{Super Numerate}, @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.V9N0LMnXf1WYseCL]{Tower of Memories}. +60% weight.
